decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits at the core of the firm's established coding portfolio and reflects substantial in-house development investment, so management will persist with it and attribute any slow uptake to the normal ramp-up of capital equipment.

The numbering software module was publicly announced as an expansion of the software portfolio and directly supports the firm's stated push toward serialization and traceability, so dropping it would contradict the announced direction.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds on the firm's ink and technology expertise and serves its one-stop solution promise, so sunk development costs and strategic fit make continuation the clear choice.
